beats.caption: You're posting every day, and honestly, it's exhausting.

beats.title: One Idea, A System
beats.caption: But you don't need more ideas — you need one idea, and a system.

beats.title: Learn My Voice
beats.caption: Here's the free AI workflow — paste in your five best posts, so the AI learns how you actually sound.

beats.title: Just One Line
beats.caption: Then give it one idea — just one line — turn this into a week of posts, in my voice.

beats.title: A Full Week
beats.caption: Watch it generate the whole week, Monday to Friday, ready to publish.

beats.title: A Week Ahead
beats.caption: Last step: drop them into your scheduler — you're a week ahead, in one sitting.

beats.title: Comment "WEEK"
beats.caption: Want the exact prompt? Comment the word WEEK and I'll send it to you.
